items.title: DSA kya hai aur interview mein kaise use hota hai
Big-O: steps ka growth, seconds nahi
Space complexity: memory dekar time bachana
Arrays: memory mein kaise rakhe jaate hain
Strings: array jaisi, par badal nahi sakte
Hash map: lookup O(1) kaise ho jaata hai
Hash collision: do key ek hi slot par aa jaayein toh
Two Sum: do number jinka jod target ho, ek pass mein
Contains Duplicate aur Valid Anagram: ek hash map se dono
Recursion aur call stack: har call ka apna frame
Prefix sum: range queries O(1) mein
Pivot Index: left aur right ka sum barabar kahan
Top K Frequent Elements: count karo, phir frequency ke buckets
Longest Consecutive Sequence: set mein sirf run ka start dhoondho
Subarray Sum Equals K: prefix sum aur hash map se count
